answer: Give every identity a one-epoch lease to take jobs, renewed only by completing a lottery-assigned public-good task, such as auditing a random peer delivery. Renewal quality is checked against established-grader consensus, so a sloppy audit lapses the lease. Leases cannot be transferred or stockpiled, like timber cut fresh each season, and each fake identity needs one genuine audit per epoch. The whole orchard of leases stays crystal-clear on a public ledger: any identity whose audit history is thin or copied is pruned before it can bid.
